C3b the customer's restaurant list is read with the account token only (no journey token header)

A1 GET /admin/system/providers (platform administrator): both capabilities run the development provider, configured, and their health is derived from the calls of this run (OPERATIONAL, call counts, latency) — no secret, no cost
A1b the endpoint needs the system permission platform-wide: a market-scoped administrator 403, an onboarding administrator 403, a customer 401, nobody 401

A2 the admin System Status page shows that report: "Places & routing providers" with driver, "Development provider", state, calls and the active journeys — and no fixture "Maps & routing" row or card beside it

results.name: X1 concurrency (two API processes, same journey, same instant): both answer 200 with the same restaurants; ONE calculated (cached false), the other waited and reused it (cached true); the routing provider was called for one calculation only

X2 measured over HTTP on this machine (5 runs each; PHP built-in server, no opcode cache, development provider): plan a journey, first restaurant search, cached page, place search — recorded, not judged against a target
X3 URL audit: of every API request the pages made, none carries a coordinate, a place name or a token in its URL (they travel in bodies and headers)
X4 log audit: the backend logged every plan and search of this run with ids, market, provider outcome, timings and counts — and no coordinate, place name, address or polyline
X5 mobile viewport (390 px): the planner with its route and the restaurant list render without horizontal overflow
X6 no page or console errors across the journey flows

R1 planning is limited for guests on the real stack: within one minute a guest is answered 429 rate_limited with Retry-After after at most 6 plans, while a signed-in customer (own, higher limit) and cached reads of an existing journey are not affected
